set.game[title]: PSX Characters Sampler: 28 Free Low Poly 3D Characters
set.game[short_text]: 28 free PS1 style low poly characters, rigged, 45 clips each, for Godot and Unity
set.game[description]:
From the same studio: the PSX Character Library holds the CSAF PSX character packs on one page, plus every new one, for $19.99.

PSX Characters Sampler is 28 free low poly PS1 style 3D characters for Godot 4, Unity and Unreal, each rigged with 45 animation clips. One character from each of our 28 paid PSX packs, 85 palette skins in all, 1494 to 1499 triangles per character and one 256 px texture per skin, in GLB, FBX, OBJ and Blender formats. Free to use in any number of commercial games, no attribution required.

What is inside

28 characters · 85 skins (three each, except where noted) · 45 clips and a T-pose on each · GLB, FBX, OBJ and the Blender source · 256 px PNG textures in 15 bit colour · a PSX shader for Godot 4.

  • Mechanic from Last Shift (survival horror): 4 skins.
  • Knight from Ironvale (fantasy).
  • High priest from Hollow Congregation (occult horror).
  • Rifleman from Fort Vale (modern military).
  • Innkeeper from Greyhollow (medieval townsfolk).
  • Station engineer from Deep Station (sci-fi horror).
  • Plague doctor from Pale Hours (supernatural horror).
  • Marine sergeant from Outpost (sci-fi colony).
  • Orc warrior from Grimsnout (orc and goblin).
  • Patrol officer from Night Beat (police).
  • Nutcracker soldier from Hollyfrost (Christmas).
  • Shambler from Blackwater (infected and zombie).
  • Construction worker from Crosstown (modern city).
  • Head nurse from Saint Oswin (asylum horror).
  • The stranger from Camp Redfern (summer camp horror).
  • Scavenger from Ashfall (post-apocalyptic).
  • Syndicate boss from Syndicate (crime syndicate).
  • British rifleman from Foxhole (WW2).
  • Fire fiend from Eight Angles (retro FPS enemies), the model only (the full pack adds his sprite sheets).
  • Black knight from Oathfall (dark fantasy).
  • Witch finder from Plaguewick (plague village).
  • King from Highcourt (royal court).
  • Containment specialist from Black Site (containment facility).
  • Rabbit mask from Butcher's Night (slasher horror).
  • Faceless man from Showa Dusk (Japanese horror).
  • Babushka from Courtyard (post-Soviet).
  • Liquidator from Cordon (exclusion zone).
  • Track walker from Kombinat (Soviet industrial).
  • The clips: idle, walk, sprint, crouch, jump, punches, sword, pistol, spell casting, hits, death, sit, swim, interact and more.
  • The shader (godot_psx.gdshader): vertex snapping, affine texture warp, 15 bit colour with dithering and fog, every setting a slider.

Garments recoloured, skin tones kept (the fire fiend changes his glowing cracks).

Works with

Godot 4: copy models/ and shaders/ into the project, instance a _skin0.glb and put the shader on the mesh. Tested in a blank Godot 4.7.2 project under Forward+, Compatibility and Mobile: every GLB imports and every clip plays. Unity 6 and Unreal 5: import the FBX (humanoid skeleton and clips included) and set point filtering in Unity, nearest in Unreal. Those two engines were not run here; Blender re-imported every FBX.

The full packs

Each pack uses the same skeleton, clips and shader, so the full casts drop into the same scene. 28 packs, each on a page of its own (listed below in release order). List prices $6.99 to $9.99. All 28 are also on one page, the PSX Character Library ($19.99), with every new pack added.

  • Last Shift: 13 survival horror characters, $9.99.
  • Ironvale: 14 fantasy characters, $7.99.
  • Hollow Congregation: 14 occult horror characters, $8.99.
  • Fort Vale: 14 modern military characters, $9.99.
  • Greyhollow: 14 medieval townsfolk characters, $8.99.
  • Deep Station: 14 sci-fi horror characters, $7.99.
  • Pale Hours: 14 supernatural horror characters, $7.99.
  • Outpost: 14 sci-fi colony characters, $7.99.
  • Grimsnout: 14 orc and goblin characters, $7.99.
  • Night Beat: 14 police characters, $7.99.
  • Hollyfrost: 14 Christmas characters, $7.99.
  • Blackwater: 14 infected and zombie characters, $7.99.
  • Crosstown: 14 modern city characters, $6.99.
  • Saint Oswin: 14 asylum horror characters, $7.99.
  • Camp Redfern: 14 summer camp horror characters, $7.99.
  • Ashfall: 14 post-apocalyptic characters, $7.99.
  • Syndicate: 14 crime syndicate characters, $7.99.
  • Foxhole: 14 WW2 characters, $7.99.
  • Eight Angles: 14 retro FPS enemies, plus 8-direction sprite sheets, $7.99.
  • Oathfall: 14 dark fantasy characters, $7.99.
  • Plaguewick: 14 plague village characters, $7.99.
  • Highcourt: 14 royal court characters, $7.99.
  • Black Site: 14 containment facility characters, $7.99.
  • Butcher's Night: 14 slasher horror characters, $7.99.
  • Showa Dusk: 14 Japanese horror characters, $7.99.
  • Courtyard: 14 post-Soviet characters, $7.99.
  • Cordon: 14 exclusion zone characters, $7.99.
  • Kombinat: 14 Soviet industrial characters, $7.99.

Sound for a PS1 style game: Horror Manor (42 PSX survival horror tracks), Dread (horror sound effects) and Cryptlight (PSX dark fantasy sound effects: dungeons, spells, armour footsteps).

Documentation: the full Readme has the import notes and the clip list.

Licence and how it was made

Use the models in any number of commercial or non-commercial games, no attribution required, and modify them freely. Do not resell or redistribute the models themselves as assets. The skeleton and clips are the CC0 Quaternius Universal Animation Library; the bodies come from MakeHuman (CC0 output).

Made with AI tools: the bodies are built in code and their textures painted by AI image models over their own renders; the code and the cover art were made with AI. Code: yes. Graphics: yes. Sounds: no. Text: no.

Versions

1.20.0 (November 23, 2026): the track walker from Kombinat joins. The other versions are described in the devlogs on this page.

If this sampler helps your game, a quick rating is the best way to support it.

Made by Core Systems Asset Factory.
